subject: general
question: Where has India's first floating elementary school been inaugurated?
solution:
The correct answer is **Loktak Lake, Manipur**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Loktak Lake** is the largest freshwater lake in northeastern India, located in Manipur.
 
• The lake is known for its unique circular floating swamps, called **phumdis**.
 
• The floating elementary school was inaugurated to provide education to children living in the lake's vicinity.
 
• It aims to address the educational needs of children from the local fishing community.
 
• The school is part of an initiative to promote sustainable living and education in remote areas.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 

 Aspect
 Description
 
 
 
 

 Location
 **Loktak Lake** is situated in the Bishnupur district of Manipur, India.
 
 

 Phumdis
 These are heterogeneous mass of vegetation, soil, and organic matter at various stages of decomposition.
 
 

 Keibul Lamjao National Park
 The only floating national park in the world, located on the southeastern shores of **Loktak Lake**.
 
 

 Fishing Community
 The lake is home to a large number of fishermen who depend on it for their livelihood.
 
 

 Environmental Concerns
 Issues such as pollution and the construction of dams have affected the lake's ecosystem.
